title: Match Alphanumerical Pattern in Matrix I
summary: Match a digit-valued board submatrix to an alphanumeric pattern. Literal digits must match exactly. Equal letters map consistently to one digit; different letters map to different digits, and a letter's digit must differ from any literal digit appearing elsewhere in the pattern. Return the matching upper-left coordinate with smallest row then column, or [-1,-1].
